name: arsel
description: Work with Arsel from your agent: manage contacts, segments and campaigns, send messages and campaigns, and read their stats through the Arsel MCP server, and write correct integrations for transactional email, SMS, WhatsApp and push, events and automations, and the web, Android and iOS SDKs.

interface.longDescription: Arsel is the marketing engagement platform for Saudi Arabia. This plugin connects the Arsel MCP server, so the agent can manage your contacts, lists, segments, templates, campaigns and automations, send transactional email, SMS, WhatsApp and push, send or schedule campaigns, and report campaign stats. Your client asks before every send. Its skills cover server-side sends of transactional email, SMS, WhatsApp and push; events that trigger automations; the web, Android and iOS SDKs for tracking and push; and writing email, SMS and WhatsApp content in Arabic and English.
defaultPrompt: Show open and click rates for my last Arsel email campaign
Send an order confirmation email and SMS through Arsel
Write an Arabic WhatsApp template that Meta will approve
